I could not verify this from a source, so the answer below is a recollection of the literature, not a derived result.

Based on my recollection of work on Pompilj automorphisms of complex Coble surfaces with irreducible boundary, the family where $T|_C = \mathbb{1}_C$ but $T \neq \mathbb{1}_X$ is a subvariety of codimension 2 in the moduli space of Coble surfaces. I am not confident in this value, and checking the original paper would be worthwhile.

ANSWER: 2
